description:
Tap and rotate pipes to solve the water network. Relaxing offline logic puzzles!
An addictive and relaxing logic puzzle game that challenges your brain and sharpens your spatial thinking. Tap and twist disconnected pipe pieces to form a complete pipeline from the source to the drain without any leaks.

Whether you want to unwind after a long day or give your mind a workout, Pipes Game offers hours of satisfying plumber puzzle mechanics.
